MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

3. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

4. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

5. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.

6. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

7. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

10. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Live streaming Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
